signature.name: VTask.constantsToVars
signature.type: {L : FirstOrder.Language} -> {α : Type u'} -> {γ : Type u_1} -> (L.withConstants γ).Term α → L.Term (γ ⊕ α)

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The function is structurally total over all well-formed terms of the extended language; every structural case is handled with no junk-value or boundary convention needed.

facts.statement: ∀ (L : FirstOrder.Language) (α γ : Type*) (n : ℕ) (f : L.Functions n) (ts : Fin n → (L.withConstants γ).Term α), VTask.constantsToVars (FirstOrder.Language.Term.func (FirstOrder.Language.LHom.sumInl.onFunction f) ts) = FirstOrder.Language.Term.func f (fun i => VTask.constantsToVars (ts i))

facts.statement: ∀ (L : FirstOrder.Language) (α γ : Type*) (t : (L.withConstants γ).Term α), FirstOrder.Language.Term.varsToConstants (VTask.constantsToVars t) = t

facts.statement: ∀ (L : FirstOrder.Language) (α β γ : Type*) (f : α → β) (t : (L.withConstants γ).Term α), VTask.constantsToVars (t.relabel f) = (VTask.constantsToVars t).relabel (Sum.map id f)

facts.statement: ∀ (L : FirstOrder.Language) (α γ : Type*) (t : (L.withConstants γ).Term α), Function.Injective (@VTask.constantsToVars L α γ) → True
